we have shown that the Pt(II) complex undergoes a phase transition under pressure and this transition is accompanied by a change in the crystal structure.
the Pt(II) complex trans PtCl 2(PEt 3) 2 undergoes a phase transition from P21/n space group to P21 space group at 0.8GPa and then to P2/n space group at 4.7GPa.

The main takeaway from our work is that
even subtle molecular reorientational motions can result in significant structural and spectroscopic changes in metal organic complexes.
the subtle molecular reorientational dynamics in metal organic complex under compression can lead to phase transition at very low pressure.
the molecular and crystal structures are highly sensitive to pressure and the subtle structural reorientations can result in significant changes in the physicochemical and catalytic properties.
